strategy.summary: Add a read-only Playwright smoke suite (tests/smoke.spec.js) for the Kettle & Co. tea shop. Each test is tagged @smoke, reaches the shop only through the configured baseURL (BASE_URL or the local webServer), and checks one critical path: the health endpoint, the catalogue, a product page, adding to the cookie cart in the browser, the cart page and the checkout form — without ever placing an order (POST /orders is the only server write).
inScope: Client-side Add to cart (cookie only, no request)
Cart page /cart from a cart cookie
outOfScope: Placing an order (POST /orders) and the order confirmation page: they write data, so they stay in the full suite (tests/checkout.spec.js)
assumptions: The catalogue (src/catalogue.js PRODUCTS) is shipped code, not seeded data, so every environment shows it; tests import PRODUCTS and formatPrice from src/catalogue.js instead of copying names/prices.
Adding to the cart and setting the cart cookie only change the test's own browser context (public/app.js writes a cookie; no request is made), so they don't write server data.
No first-party service is faked: the tests run against the real shop (local webServer from playwright.config.js, or a deployed build via BASE_URL). The shop has no sign-in.
The tests are not run in this session (target is a non-disposable deployed build); the PR's CI (npx playwright test) runs them.

risks.description: A smoke test accidentally submits the checkout form and places a real order in production.
risks.mitigation: The checkout case only asserts the form's fields and button are visible; no test clicks Place order or issues a non-GET request.
Names and prices are imported from src/catalogue.js.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The deployed shop is up: GET /health answers 200 with {"status":"ok"}.
A user can open the catalogue and see every product with its price.
A user can open a product page showing its name, price and an Add to cart button.
A user can add a product to the cart in the browser and the cart count updates.
A user with items in the cart sees them and the total on the cart page.
A user with items in the cart can reach the checkout form (Name, Email, Address, Place order).
Every smoke test is tagged @smoke in its title, reaches the app only through the base URL, and only reads (no order placed, no POST).
acceptanceCriteria.metBy: tests/smoke.spec.js: every test title ends in @smoke, uses relative paths against Playwright's baseURL, and makes only GET requests (page.goto/request.get); no form is submitted.

testCases.title: health endpoint reports the shop is up @smoke
testCases.rationale: Critical path: the app starts and answers; the cheapest go/no-go signal.

testCases.title: catalogue lists every product with its price @smoke
testCases.expected: Heading 'Our teaware'; a link per product in PRODUCTS by exact name, each list item showing its formatted price
testCases.rationale: Critical path: the home page/catalogue is the entry point of every purchase.

testCases.title: product page shows the product and an Add to cart button @smoke
steps: Open / and click the first product's link
testCases.expected: URL /products/<id>; heading is the product name; price shown; Add to cart button visible
testCases.rationale: Critical path: reaching a product from the catalogue.

testCases.title: adding a product updates the cart count @smoke
testCases.expected: Status 'Added to your cart'; header link reads 'Cart (1)'
testCases.rationale: Critical path: the client script (app.js) loads and the cart works; writes only a browser cookie.

testCases.title: cart page shows the items in the cart and their total @smoke
preconditions: cart cookie set for baseURL, e.g. <id>:2
steps: Add cart cookie to the context
testCases.expected: Heading 'Your cart'; a row for the product with quantity 2; total equals formatted 2× price; 'Go to checkout' link visible
testCases.rationale: Critical path: the server reads the cart and renders the basket.

testCases.title: checkout page shows the order form without placing an order @smoke
testCases.expected: Heading 'Checkout'; Name, Email, Address fields and 'Place order' button visible; nothing submitted
testCases.rationale: Critical path: checkout is reachable; placing the order is left to the full suite because it writes.

strategy.environmentNotes: BASE_URL selects a deployed build; without it playwright.config.js starts node src/server.js on 4175. CI runs npx playwright test after installing chromium.

refusals.reason: tests/smoke.spec.js written before testforge:api, testforge:implementation were loaded
`playwright` runs tests, and this run writes a smoke suite for http://host.docker.internal:61644, which isn't marked disposable, without running it.
